newsitem.title: ITALY: Snow spells soft landing for Italian toddler.
newsitem.headline: Snow spells soft landing for Italian toddler.

text.p: A four-year-old boy plunged from the window of a sixth floor apartment and got up virtually unhurt after landing in snow, the Italian news agency ANSA reported on Friday.
Mauro Anastasi suffered nothing worse than a scratch on the chin and bruises but was being kept under observation for 48 hours in hospital after Thursday's 20-metre (65 ft) fall, the agency said.
The incident happened in the town of Pioltello, just outside Milan, where up to 40 cm (16 inches) of snow has fallen since New Year's Eve in the winter cold snap gripping much of Europe.
